outputs.explanation: Panel A is a macroscopic photograph of intestines, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows histological (H&E) micrographs, not a plot.

Panel C includes a box plot (which is exempt, as it already conveys distribution) but also a 3D bar chart of mean polyp numbers per genotype/diameter bin (n=8–18 per genotype) that shows only bar heights with no overlaid individual data points.
Panel D is a Kaplan–Meier survival curve, a line plot type that is exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E includes immunoblots plus a bar chart quantifying relative GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels with error bars, but no individual data points are shown for the underlying replicate measurements.
Panel F consists of immunohistochemistry micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G includes immunoblots/zymography plus a bar chart of relative expression (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) with error bars, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
